question: What is the smallest positive integer such that its product with 252 is a perfect square?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ 252 = 2² × 3² × 7

⇒ Pair already: 2², 3²

⇒ Unpaired = 7

⇒ Multiply by 7 to make pair

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 252

**Formula Used:**

A number is a perfect square if all prime factors have even powers

**Calculation:**

⇒ 252 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 7

⇒ = 2² × 3² × 7

⇒ 7 has odd power

⇒ Multiply by 7 to make it 7²

⇒ Required number = 7

**∴ Final Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Perfect Square Rule:** All prime factors must have even powers

**Prime Factorization:** Break number into primes to analyze powers

**Shortcut Tip:** Multiply unpaired factors only

**Example:** 18 = 2 × 3² → need 2 to make square
